reviews.title: Unforgettable Lake Tana Retreat
reviews.comment: The calm courtyard fountain and the fresh grilled fish at Galleria made our holiday wonderful. Classic Bahir Dar hospitality at its finest.

reviews.title: Warm Ethiopian hospitality and peaceful garden
reviews.comment: Dib Anbessa Hotel is a genuine classic in Bahir Dar. The hand-carved woodwork in the rooms, the quiet courtyard fountain, and the warm service by the front desk team made our stay truly memorable. The fresh Lake Tana fish at Galleria Restaurant was prepared to perfection.

reviews.title: Authentic character, not a soulless corporate hotel
reviews.comment: If you want to experience real Ethiopian hospitality and classic architecture with character, this is the place. The curved balconies overlooking the palm avenue, the traditional art in the lobby, and the helpful staff who arranged our Blue Nile Falls trip made it a highlight of our trip.

reviews.title: Clean rooms, historic atmosphere, and great central location
reviews.comment: The hotel has an established charm you rarely find today. Spacious rooms with comfortable beds and nice balconies. Very convenient to walk to the market and quick drive to the lake boat departure point. The staff greeted us with warm smiles every day.
